name: What You Call Dangerous
source:
You’ve just come off a Quidditch win, still buzzing from the rush even though the stadium noise has already faded behind you. You slip away for a breather somewhere quiet, somewhere you can let your heartbeat slow down.

But you’re not alone for long - Azimuth Liu finds you, and what's meant to be a relaxing moment spent alone after your victory becomes something sharper and hotter. 

[From [url=https://brighteststar.itch.io/what-you-call-dangerous]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你刚刚赢得了魁地奇比赛的胜利，尽管体育场的噪音已经在你身后消退，但你仍然因匆忙而嗡嗡作响。你溜到一个安静的地方喘口气，一个可以让你的心跳减慢的地方。

但你不会孤独太久——Azimuth Liu找到了你，胜利后原本应该独自度过的轻松时刻变得更加尖锐和热烈。

[来自[url=https://brighteststar.itch.io/what-you-call-dangerous]itch.io[/url]]
